query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `inAppNotifications` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `userId` int NOT NULL,
  `type` enum('boutique_signup', 'try_on_complete', 'credits_low', 'product_added', 'boutique_verified', 'payment_received', 'customer_inquiry', 'system') NOT NULL,
  `title` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `message` text NOT NULL,
  `relatedEntityType` varchar(100),
  `relatedEntityId` int,
  `read` int DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  `readAt` timestamp NULL,
  `actionUrl` varchar(500),
  `createdAt` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`userId`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`),
  INDEX `idx_in_app_notifications_user` (`userId`),
  INDEX `idx_in_app_notifications_read` (`read`),
  INDEX `idx_in_app_notifications_created` (`createdAt`),
  INDEX `idx_in_app_notifications_type` (`type`)
);
